name: InterContinental Bahrain
insider_take: This towering landmark isn't just Bahrain's tallest building – it's an architectural marvel that literally bridges two worlds, connecting to the exclusive Four Seasons via a stunning sky bridge 50 floors above the city.
whats_special: The InterContinental Bahrain occupies floors 18-49 of the iconic Bahrain Financial Harbour towers, offering unparalleled views of the Arabian Gulf and Manama's glittering skyline. The hotel's unique dual-tower design creates a dramatic "gateway" effect that's become synonymous with modern Bahrain's ambitious spirit.
pro_tip: Book a club-level room to access the exclusive 47th-floor Club InterContinental lounge – it's one of the highest hotel lounges in the Middle East with breathtaking 360-degree views.
dont_miss: The hotel's infinity pool appears to spill directly into the Persian Gulf from your high-altitude perch, while the nearby Bahrain National Museum and traditional Manama Souq offer fascinating glimpses into the kingdom's pearl-diving heritage just minutes away.
pros: Prime waterfront location in Manama's diplomatic area
Expansive luxury spa and wellness facilities
Stunning Arabian Gulf views from rooms and suites
cons: Formal atmosphere may not suit casual travelers
